verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, a CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without the web UI. It also documents an HTTP API for evaluating gates, experiments and configs and logging events, with per-endpoint API reference pages. Together these let a programmatic or AI-native user drive the product end-to-end through a documented public API. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
